topic: How can frequency planning address interference between satellite uplinks and broadband power line communication systems?
consensus_response: Frequency planning plays a critical role in mitigating interference between satellite uplinks and power line communications. Dynamic spectrum sharing, frequency hopping, and dedicated frequency allocation are effective techniques that allow networks to share the same bandwidth while minimizing overlap. These strategies minimize interference by dynamically adjusting frequencies, ensuring minimal delays in data transmission protocols.  However, careful consideration of channel capacity is essential as these techniques can impact network performance and future expansion.
